sections.heading: Understanding Hard Money for Fix and Flip Projects

These loans prioritize the property's value and the investor's experience over traditional credit metrics, enabling quick access to capital. AssetLift Lending specializes in connecting investors with hard money options that cater specifically to the rapid timelines and capital needs of fix and flip projects. Our partners offer up to 95% Loan-to-Cost (LTC) on the purchase price and can fund 100% of the rehab costs, ensuring investors have the necessary capital for their projects. This structure is designed to maximize leverage and minimize out-of-pocket expenses, allowing investors to scale their portfolio more efficiently. Loans range from $100,000 to $5 million, accommodating a wide spectrum of investment sizes.

sections.heading: Understanding DSCR Loans with No Income Verification
sections.content: DSCR (Debt Service Coverage Ratio) loans are designed specifically for real estate investors, evaluating a property's potential rental income against its mortgage payment to determine loan eligibility, rather than the borrower's personal income. This means no W-2s, tax returns, or personal income verification are typically required, streamlining the application process significantly. AssetLift Lending specializes in connecting investors with these non-QM (non-qualified mortgage) products through its network of white-label capital partners. For investors seeking to expand their portfolios without the traditional income documentation hurdles, DSCR loans offer a powerful solution. AssetLift Lending facilitates DSCR rental loans for purchases up to 85% LTV and for cash-out refinances up to 80% LTV, with competitive rates starting from 5.85% for qualifying deals.
